subtitle: A recipe box your AI fills from recipes you paste.
about: A note linking to recipes, each in its own note with an ingredient checklist, servings and numbered steps. Paste a recipe into your AI to file it, then tick off ingredients as you cook.

ask.prompt: Set up the recipe box template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Covers and cards
